scope: Executed source-conditioned reset/energy/charge and behavioral coupled-startup diagnostics; NOT functional native-controller or physical proof

guarantee_conditions: R13 remains intact within its selected tolerance; CDD<=stated maximum.
Fault has actually stopped switching; all other VDD loads are passive.
External/auxiliary injected current is zero for no-injection upper bound, or below the explicitly selected uniform bound.
IFAULT95/125uA entries used uniformly are sensitivities; TI specifies atVDD25V. No IRUN/IFAULT minimum is invented.
reset.R13open: Without a positive lower bound on actual internal discharge current, this passive reset proof is lost.

limitations: Official available encrypted model is28710 and CBC is not modeled; no28711NTC native model is supplied.
ActualHV I-V over the charging trajectory and controller states is not specified by100/250/500uA atVDD0. Fixed100uA stall is a diagnostic, not established actual failure.
Backup supply power-up/reset/output-off leakage, regulator dynamic input current and capacitor effective bias/temperature/ESR must be established before ECO acceptance.
Pulse count and Ipk assumptions are not measured or guaranteed dynamic fault maxima; no11W fault power cap is used.
